matched_control_unit.reason: Each of the 22 preregistered control assignments is indexed to a specific failed bank and pseudo-index date; a repeated institution under a different pseudo-index date is a distinct matched-control observation.

control_warning_window: Only warning-evaluable quarters strictly before the assigned failed bank pseudo-index date are eligible for false-positive classification.
control_evaluable_rule: At least one warning-evaluable quarter before the pseudo-index date after the rolling histories mature.

additive_rank_scale.quarter_score: arithmetic mean normalized health rank across evaluable factors
additive_rank_scale.warning_condition: quarter_score <= 1/3 for two consecutive reported quarters

additive_lead_and_false_positive_rules: Identical to UCIC lead-time, pseudo-index, missing-data, and control evaluability rules.

redundancy_rule.interpretation: If true, the FDIC extension provides no empirical advantage for the noncompensatory UCIC warning rule over the frozen additive comparator on the primary failure/control metrics.

terminal_mapping.when: fewer than 9 failed banks or fewer than 18 matched control assignments are evaluable
any of the seven frozen UCIC continuation thresholds fails
all seven UCIC thresholds pass and ADDITIVE_WEAK_DOMINANCE is true
all seven UCIC thresholds pass, additive also passes all analogous thresholds, but ADDITIVE_WEAK_DOMINANCE is false
all seven UCIC thresholds pass and additive fails at least one analogous threshold
